title: CATER.
text:
The Vision
CATER isn’t just a research center; it’s a collaborative network. We believe that the intersection of technology and pedagogy requires a new kind of infrastructure—one that is open, rigorous, and rapid.
Read the Full Manifesto →

title: About the Center
text:
To understand CATER, you must understand our three-pronged approach to the future of education.



“We don’t just use tools; we build them.”

Research in tech-education is often limited by the quality of the measurement. We focus on developing: * Validated Scales for digital literacy. * Open-source software for classroom data analysis. * Methodological frameworks for longitudinal tech studies.



Research that stays in a PDF is research that hasn’t finished its job. Our translation wing works to: * Create evidence-based toolkits for teachers. * Advise on national curriculum standards. * Produce accessible media explaining tech impacts on the developing brain.



Inspired by the Psychological Science Accelerator, we provide the “CATER Network”—a way for researchers to: * Crowdsource data collection across different countries. * Find peer-reviewers who understand the tech-pedagogy niche. * Share code and datasets in a secure, ethical environment.




Jeff Buckley, PhD Director of CATER
